description: Adds new picklist values to an existing Picklist or MultiselectPicklist field without removing existing values. Use when a user wants to add new options to a dropdown.

objectFieldFullName.description: Full API name of the picklist field, e.g. 'Invoice__c.Status__c'

values.description: New picklist values to add (existing values are preserved)

default.description: Whether this is the default value

fullName.description: API name for the picklist value (e.g. 'New')

isActive.description: Whether the value is active (default true)

name: sf_add_picklist_values
title: Add Picklist Values to Existing Field
